examples.en: I play chess with a friend every weekend.
Chess has rules that are a bit difficult.
I learned how to play chess from my father.
My younger sibling won a prize at a chess tournament.
My hobbies are chess and reading.
The pieces disappeared from the chessboard one by one.

explain: 체스는 '두다'와 같이 써요. '체스를 두다'처럼 말해요. 바둑이나 장기도 '두다'를 쓰고, 카드 게임은 '치다'를 써요.

phrases.en: I play chess with my father in the evening.
phrases.nuance_ko: 체스는 '하다'보다 '두다'와 자연스럽게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Chess pairs naturally with '두다' rather than '하다'.

phrases.en: There is a chessboard on the desk.
phrases.nuance_ko: 체스를 두는 판을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The board on which chess is played.

phrases.en: A chess tournament is held at school.
phrases.nuance_ko: 체스로 겨루는 대회를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a competition based on chess.

explain_en: Chess goes with the verb '두다': '체스를 두다'. Go (바둑) and Korean chess (장기) also use '두다', while card games use '치다'.

examples.ko: 어릴 때 동네 형과 팔씨름 대결을 한 적이 있어요.
examples.en: When I was little, I once had an arm-wrestling match with an older boy from the neighborhood.
In arm wrestling, wrist strength is important.
We arm wrestled for a bet and I lost.
I want to beat my father at arm wrestling.

examples.ko: 점심 내기로 팔씨름 한 판 할래요?
examples.en: Want to arm wrestle once for lunch?
As soon as the arm wrestling ended, my arm was tingling.

explain: '팔씨름을 하다'라고 하고, 한 번 겨루는 건 '한 판'으로 세요. '씨름'은 한국 전통 레슬링인데, '팔씨름'은 팔만으로 힘을 겨루는 놀이예요.

phrases.en: I arm wrestled with a friend at lunchtime.
phrases.nuance_ko: 팔씨름 놀이를 한다고 말할 때 가장 기본으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The basic way to say you play arm wrestling.

phrases.en: Shall we have one round of arm wrestling?
phrases.nuance_ko: 한 번 겨루는 것을 '한 판'으로 세요.
phrases.nuance_en: One match is counted as '한 판'.

phrases.en: My older brother won the arm wrestling and was happy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 결과를 말할 때 '이기다', '지다'를 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 이기다 or 지다 to talk about the result.

explain_en: You say '팔씨름을 하다', and one round is counted as '한 판'. '씨름' is traditional Korean wrestling, while '팔씨름' is a contest of strength using just the arm.

examples.en: The light in my room keeps flickering, which makes me uneasy.
Don't cross when the green light starts blinking.
I was so sleepy that my eyes kept blinking.
The stars are twinkling and flickering in the night sky.
I saw the phone's light blinking.
I changed the settings so the screen doesn't flicker.

explain: '깜박이다'보다 되풀이되는 느낌이 강해서 고장 난 전등이나 점멸 신호등에 잘 어울려요. '전등이 깜박거리다'처럼 주어에 '이/가'를 써요. 헷갈리기 쉬운 '깜박하다'는 '잊다'에 가까운 전혀 다른 말이에요.

phrases.en: I can see a flickering light in the distance.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-는'으로 뒤의 명사를 꾸며 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: The '-는' ending modifies the noun that follows.

phrases.en: The traffic light keeps blinking.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 계속 일어나는 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for something that keeps happening right now.

phrases.en: The light flickered a few times.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지난 일을 말하는 과거형이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The past form for something that already happened.

explain_en: It feels more repeated than '깜박이다', so it suits a faulty lamp or a blinking signal. You say '전등이 깜박거리다', with '이/가' on the subject. Don't confuse it with '깜박하다', a different word closer to 'forget'.

t90.ax: I saw the phone's light blinking.

examples.en: We clean up together after dinner.
Who cleans up after the meeting ends?
I'll stay behind, clean up, and then go.
I teach the children to clean up after themselves.
After the event, everyone cleaned up together.
You have to leave the campsite clean.

explain: '정리하다'보다 일이나 모임이 끝난 뒤 남은 것을 치운다는 뜻이 분명해요. '다 같이 뒷정리해요', '뒷정리하고 가요'처럼 쓰고, 명사 '뒷정리'로 '뒷정리를 맡다'처럼 말하기도 해요.

phrases.en: I'll clean up for you.
phrases.nuance_ko: 다른 사람을 위해 치워 줄 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when cleaning up for someone else.

phrases.en: If you're done eating, clean up and go.
phrases.nuance_ko: 두 동작을 이어서 말할 때 '-고'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use -고 to connect two actions.

phrases.en: The event is over, so we have to clean up.
phrases.nuance_ko: 해야 하는 일이라고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say it's something that must be done.

explain_en: Compared with '정리하다', it clearly means putting away what is left after a task or gathering. It is used as '다 같이 뒷정리해요' or '뒷정리하고 가요', and the noun form works in '뒷정리를 맡다'.

t90.ax: We clean up together after dinner.

examples.en: I smoothed the clothes with a steam iron.
Steam comes out, so the room is warm.
When I turn on the steam, my face gets moist.
Dumplings cooked in steam are soft.
I am careful not to burn my hand on the steam.

examples.ko: 스팀 때문에 욕실 거울이 뿌옇게 됐어요.
examples.en: The bathroom mirror fogged up because of the steam.

explain: '스팀 다리미', '스팀 청소기'처럼 가전 이름에 들어가요. '스팀 난방'처럼 증기로 방을 덥히는 난방도 가리켜요. 뜨거운 물에서 나는 김은 그냥 '김'이라고도 해요.

phrases.en: I cleaned the floor with a steam cleaner.
phrases.nuance_ko: 증기로 청소하는 가전 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The name of a home appliance that cleans with steam.

phrases.en: My home has steam heating, so it's warm.
phrases.nuance_ko: 증기로 방을 덥히는 난방을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Heating that warms a room using steam.

phrases.en: This washing machine has a steam function.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가전제품에서 증기를 쓰는 기능을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a steam feature on home appliances.

explain_en: It appears in appliance names like 'steam iron' and 'steam cleaner'. It also refers to heating that warms a room with steam, as in '스팀 난방'. The vapor from hot water is also simply called '김'.

t90.ax: Dumplings cooked in steam are soft.

examples.en: I painted the old wardrobe.
I can see a house painted white in the distance.
The paint is peeling, so I have to redo it.
Painting the wall takes just two days.

examples.ko: 페인트칠 하는 동안 창문을 열어 두세요.
examples.en: Keep the windows open while painting.
Can you lend me a brush to use for painting?

explain: '페인트를 칠하다'와 같은 뜻이고, '페인트칠을 하다'로도 말해요. 벽에 벽지를 붙이는 일은 '도배'라고 해서 구분해요.

phrases.en: I painted my room over the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 벽이나 가구에 페인트를 칠하는 일을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to putting paint on walls or furniture.

phrases.en: The wall painted white looks clean.
phrases.nuance_ko: '페인트칠하다'를 명사 앞에서 꾸며 주는 모양으로 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb form 페인트칠하다 can be used before a noun to describe it.

phrases.en: The paint on the old gate has peeled off.
phrases.nuance_ko: 오래되어 칠한 부분이 떨어질 때 '벗겨지다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with 벗겨지다 when old paint comes off.

explain_en: It means the same as '페인트를 칠하다' and can also be said as '페인트칠을 하다'. Putting wallpaper on walls is called '도배', which is a different job.

examples.ko: 주말에 가족과 과천에 있는 대공원에 갔어요.
examples.en: On the weekend I went to the large park in Gwacheon with my family.

examples.ko: 대공원은 걸어서 한 바퀴 도는 데 두 시간 걸려요.
examples.en: It takes two hours to walk around the large park.

examples.ko: 이 대공원 안에 큰 동물원이 있어요.
examples.en: There is a big zoo inside this large park.

examples.ko: 대공원 입구에서 자전거를 한 시간 빌렸어요.
examples.en: I rented a bicycle for an hour at the entrance of the large park.
In spring, many flowers bloom in the large park.
You can get to the large park by subway.

explain: 대공원은 보통 이름에 붙어요. '서울대공원'처럼 공원 이름으로 쓰기도 하고, 일반 공원보다 훨씬 넓은 공원을 가리키기도 해요. 작은 동네 공원은 그냥 '공원'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: Seoul Grand Park has a zoo.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대공원이 들어간 실제 공원 이름이에요. 한국에서 아주 유명한 곳이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A real park name that includes 대공원; it is a very famous place in Korea.

phrases.en: I'm meeting my friend at the entrance of the large park.
phrases.nuance_ko: 만나는 장소를 정할 때 '입구'와 함께 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used with 입구 when choosing a meeting place.

phrases.en: I took a walk in the large park on Sunday morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: '에서'를 붙여 공원 안에서 하는 활동을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add 에서 to say what you do inside the park.
phrases.en_equiv: to take a walk in the large park

explain_en: 대공원 usually appears as part of a name. It can be a proper name like '서울대공원' (Seoul Grand Park), or it can point to a park much bigger than an ordinary one. A small neighborhood park is just '공원'.

examples.en: I put on lotion after washing my face.

examples.ko: 로션이 거의 떨어져서 새로 사야 해요.
examples.en: The lotion is almost gone, so I need to buy more.

examples.ko: 이 로션은 향이 은은하고 끈적이지 않아요.
examples.en: This lotion has a gentle scent and is not sticky.

examples.ko: 아기 피부는 로션으로 매일 관리해 줘요.
examples.en: I care for the baby's skin with lotion every day.
I received a bottle of lotion as a gift.
I packed both lotion and sunscreen in my bag.

explain: 얼굴 관리 제품은 '스킨', '로션', '크림'처럼 이름을 나눠 불러요. 모두 '바르다'를 써요.

phrases.en: After a shower I put lotion on my body.
phrases.nuance_ko: 피부에 문지르듯 바를 때 '바르다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use '바르다' for applying it onto skin.

phrases.en: In winter, body lotion is a must.
phrases.nuance_ko: 얼굴이 아니라 몸에 바르는 로션이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Lotion for the body rather than the face.

phrases.en: I bought a bottle of lotion at the mart.
phrases.nuance_ko: 로션은 '병'으로 세요.
phrases.nuance_en: Lotion is counted with '병' (bottle).

explain_en: Face-care products are named separately, such as 스킨, 로션, and 크림. All of them take the verb 바르다.

examples.ko: 더운 날에는 차가운 메밀국수가 먹고 싶어요.
examples.en: On hot days I want to eat cold buckwheat noodles.
I tried eating the buckwheat noodles with grated radish.
Buckwheat noodles are a bit coarse and nutty.
I ordered a bowl of buckwheat noodles for lunch.
After boiling the buckwheat noodles, rinse them in cold water.
This restaurant is famous for its buckwheat noodles.

explain: '막국수'도 메밀로 만든 국수라서 서로 가까운 음식이에요. 일본어 '소바'를 한국어로는 '메밀국수'라고 옮기는 경우가 많아요. 국수는 '삶다', 찬물에 '헹구다'처럼 요리 동사와 함께 나와요.

phrases.en: I ate makguksu in Chuncheon.
phrases.nuance_ko: 메밀로 만든 강원도식 국수로, 메밀국수와 가까운 음식이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A Gangwon-style noodle also made from buckwheat, close to 메밀국수.

phrases.en: I boiled the buckwheat noodles and rinsed them in cold water.
phrases.nuance_ko: 요리할 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A phrase used when cooking the noodles.

phrases.en: One bowl of buckwheat noodles, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 식당에서 주문할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when ordering at a restaurant.

explain_en: '막국수' is also made from buckwheat, so the two dishes are close. The Japanese 'soba' is often rendered in Korean as '메밀국수'. It appears with cooking verbs such as '삶다' (boil) and '헹구다' (rinse).

examples.en: The spacecraft launch is tomorrow.
I watched the rocket launch on TV.
The launch was postponed because of the weather.
A loud sound came at the moment of launch.
The news said the satellite launch succeeded.
There are ten minutes left until launch.

explain: 주로 로켓, 우주선, 인공위성처럼 하늘로 보내는 일에 써요. '발사 성공', '발사 시간'처럼 명사끼리 이어 말하는 일이 많아요. '발사하다', '발사되다'와 같은 뿌리의 말이에요.

phrases.en: The launch time is ten o'clock at night.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사끼리 이어서 '언제 쏘는지'를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A noun compound saying when the launch happens.

phrases.en: This rocket was launched successfully.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-에 성공하다'로 결과가 좋았다고 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: '-에 성공하다' says the launch went well.

phrases.en: The launch was postponed because of the weather.
phrases.nuance_ko: 예정보다 늦춰졌다는 뜻으로 뉴스에서 자주 들려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means delayed from the plan; common in news.

explain_en: It is mostly used for sending rockets, spacecraft and satellites into the sky. Nouns often chain with it, as in '발사 성공' and '발사 시간'. It shares a root with '발사하다' and '발사되다'.

examples.ko: 방 안에 책상을 창문 쪽으로 배치해요.
examples.en: I arrange the desk toward the window in the room.

examples.ko: 가게 입구에 의자를 두 개 배치했어요.
examples.en: We placed two chairs at the entrance of the shop.

examples.ko: 가구를 다르게 배치하면 방이 넓어 보여요.
examples.en: If you arrange the furniture differently, the room looks bigger.
They placed guides all around the airport.
The coach is thinking about where to place the players.

examples.ko: 신입 사원을 다음 달에 영업팀에 배치할 거예요.
examples.en: We will assign the new employee to the sales team next month.

explain: '놓다'나 '두다'는 그냥 놓는 일이고, '배치하다'는 어디에 둘지 생각해서 자리를 정하는 느낌이에요. 물건뿐 아니라 사람에게도 써서 '직원을 배치하다'라고 해요. 명사 '배치'는 '자리 배치', '좌석 배치'처럼 써요.

phrases.en: We assign the new staff member to the information desk.
phrases.nuance_ko: 해요체로 일상에서 현재 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The polite present form for everyday use.

phrases.en: I arranged the chairs by the window.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 끝난 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for something that is already done.

phrases.en: We changed the seating arrangement in the classroom.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사 '배치'가 붙은 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing with the noun 'baechi'.

explain_en: '놓다' and '두다' just mean putting something down, while 'baechihada' implies deciding where each thing goes. It works for people too, as in '직원을 배치하다' (assign staff). The noun '배치' appears in '자리 배치' (seating plan) and '좌석 배치' (seat layout).

t90.ax: They placed guides all around the airport.
